catalog_source_of_truth: engine/src/algorithms/catalog.toml in the KiteO repo. The scored vocabulary is pinned to kiteo-39-v1; other catalog.toml names are valid only in techniques_observed. A new catalog version is created deliberately, never silently.

status_meaning.seed_only: Reference from a public list. No source fetched. Labels are hints, not truth.
status_meaning.fetched: Exact source fetched and pinned (commit, path, hash). Not yet audited.
status_meaning.agent_audited: Labels derived from the source by the audit agent without running KiteO. NOT ground truth yet.
status_meaning.human_confirmed: A person confirmed the labels. Only this status counts as ground truth for approving detectors or reporting held-out accuracy.
status_meaning.label_disputed: Reasonable readings disagree. Excluded from scoring until resolved.
status_meaning.excluded: Removed (duplicate, language mismatch, missing source, license problem, bad code).

value_conventions.pending: null means not audited yet. Never use [] or a guessed value as a placeholder.
value_conventions.expected_algorithms: null = not audited. [] = audited, no catalog algorithm, so KiteO should output no label. Otherwise 1 to 3 catalog labels, dominant first.
value_conventions.expected_tc_expected_sc: Canonical string such as O(n log n), or the literal Unknown when the correct answer is that KiteO cannot determine it. null = not audited.
value_conventions.variables: Subset of n, m, q, k, V, E, A. null = not audited.

field_notes.pair_id: Same problem in both languages shares one pair_id (for C++/Java equivalence tests). null if unpaired.
field_notes.rating_source: e.g. codeforces_api. Never invent a rating.
field_notes.accepted_evidence: How acceptance is known (repo claim, submission link). Use repo_claim_only if nothing better. Never fabricate.
field_notes.techniques_observed: Free-text techniques seen in the code (Greedy, Math, Kadane...). Never scored. Keeps audit facts when the catalog grows.
field_notes.negative_for: Catalog labels this case deliberately looks like but must NOT trigger (look-alike negatives).
field_notes.split: dev or heldout, from the stratified manifest. Held-out labels live outside the engine workspace.
field_notes.audited_by: agent id or human name; human_confirmed requires a human.
